name: QA-1125-TL-01: A range offer accepted at one amount shows that amount in the Offer summary
description:
Objective: A range offer accepted at one amount shows that amount in the right-side Offer summary.
Preconditions: Kesef CRM QA at the configured origin; authorized test account; an existing application in the needed state discovered read-only, or an unsaved intake whose writes are blocked.
Steps:
1. Find an application whose range offer was accepted at one amount (read-only).
2. Open Application Details.
3. Read the right-side Offer card.
Expected: 1. The Offer card shows the accepted amount, not the offered range.
